# MID-TERM PROJECT OF R-PROGRAMMING

## Installation and calling the packages for loading data

```{r inst, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("readxl","readr"))
```

```{r packages}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
```

## Loading CO2 Emmission & Population data

```{r load-co2}
co2_emmission <- read_csv("C:/Users/enzabihimana/OneDrive - SanlamAllianz/Documents/R/R-first-project/CO2_emission.csv")
```

```{r load-pop}
world_pop <- read_csv("C:/Users/enzabihimana/OneDrive - SanlamAllianz/Documents/R/R-first-project/world_population.csv")
```
